name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1. An alternate replacement for scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev, not a stage alongside them. Requires workspace-init: /ossify:start refuses without its pairing manifest. /ossify:start opens a release, /ossify:plan-release and /ossify:plan-spine lay out the skeleton, /ossify:run-spine drives a planned spine's rounds, /ossify:close runs the close ceremony, /ossify:doctor diagnoses state, spec, rules, interop and budgets, plus the any-repo /ossify:handoff and /ossify:work-pr. Round execution dispatches a Claude Code subagent.
